name: Customer support
summary: Tickets opened, closed and open, the old ones, first response and resolution times, satisfaction and reopens, with a weekly dashboard and a Workflow that asks for last week's figures on Monday.

whatItsFor.text: For a support team that wants to see every week how much comes in and goes out, what is waiting, how fast it is answered and how customers rate it.

items: The week's figures from your ticket system: tickets opened, closed and open, those open over 7 days, first response and resolution times, satisfaction and reopen rate.
Free room for the Metrics in your Workspace's size: the Set up form says how many it makes and how many fit.
Open **Settings**, then **Packs**. Under this Pack, choose **Set up from this Pack**.

Keep the Metrics you want ticked, up to all 8, with the dashboard **Support weekly** and the Workflow **Monday support figures**. Leave **Make me the Submitter of their values** ticked if you send the figures yourself, else untick it. Setting up sends no request unless you tick **Send the first requests now**. Choose **Set up**.

If someone else sends figures, do this right after Set up: open the **Setup Guide** from **Help**, choose **Team**, and under **Who is asked for what** pick the person for each Metric and press **Ask**. It lists your ten newest Metrics.
Send the first figures: open a Metric you submit and choose **Record a value**, or answer the request the Workflow sends at its next run.
Open **Dashboards** and then **Support weekly**. It fills as values come in.
**Tickets opened**, **Tickets closed**, **Open tickets** and **Tickets open over 7 days**.
**First response time** and **Resolution time** in hours, **Customer satisfaction** and **Reopen rate** as shares.
The Workflow **Monday support figures** asks for last week's figures on Monday and publishes them. A figure that is still missing after its Due Date is raised with the Metric's owner.

questions.text: Can the figures come from a spreadsheet?
Yes. On a Metric's **Description** tab, **Fill from n8n** under **Who submits** offers the Google Sheets template for the ticket counts and the satisfaction.

metric.name: Tickets opened
metric.description: Support tickets that customers opened in the week.
metric.calculationNote: Every new ticket a customer opened from Monday to Sunday, on any channel. Spam, duplicates and tickets the team opened itself are left out.

metric.name: Tickets closed
metric.description: Support tickets that were resolved and closed in the week.
metric.calculationNote: Tickets set to resolved or closed from Monday to Sunday, whenever they were opened. Spam and merged duplicates are left out.

metric.name: Open tickets
metric.description: Tickets still open at the end of the week.
metric.calculationNote: Tickets not yet resolved on Sunday evening, including those waiting for the customer.

metric.name: Tickets open over 7 days
metric.description: Tickets that have been open for more than seven days at the end of the week.
metric.calculationNote: Tickets still open on Sunday evening that were opened more than seven calendar days before. It is part of the open tickets, not in addition to them.

metric.name: First response time
metric.description: The average hours from a ticket arriving to the first human answer, for the tickets answered in the week.
metric.calculationNote: The time from a ticket arriving to the first answer a person wrote, averaged over the tickets answered in the week. Automatic replies do not count, and nights and weekends are included.

metric.name: Resolution time
metric.description: The average hours from a ticket arriving to it being resolved, for the tickets resolved in the week.
metric.calculationNote: The time from a ticket arriving to it being resolved, averaged over the tickets resolved in the week. Nights, weekends and time waiting for the customer are included.

metric.name: Customer satisfaction
metric.description: The share of rated tickets where the customer was satisfied, in the week.
metric.calculationNote: Tickets rated as satisfied divided by all tickets rated in the week, in percent. Tickets without a rating are not counted either way.

metric.name: Reopen rate
metric.description: The share of resolved tickets that the customer reopened, in the week.
metric.calculationNote: Resolved tickets of the week that the customer opened again, divided by all tickets resolved in it, in percent.
